title: Perpetually Fair Assignments Via Balanced Sequences of Permutations
summary: There is a set of $n$ indivisible items (goods or chores), and a set of $n$ players. Each day, a single item should be assigned to each player. Assignments based on latin squares guarantee fairness after every $n$ days; our goal is to ensure fairness after every single day. We present two 'balance' conditions on latin squares. Informally, a latin square is balanced if its top rows and leftmost columns contain all $n$ labels; this ensures that all $n$ players receive one of the top items in one of the early days.
